blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
At enterprise level, customs and compliance are no longer operational tasks — they are strategic disciplines that increasingly shape where a company can operate, how it can structure its flows, and how it is perceived by regulators that do not forget. A single sanctions oversight, even years ago, can close doors that the company did not know were opening. A single pattern of declared values that looks careless can mark the entire organisation in a way that costs quietly for a decade.

Senior leaders invest in three things. First, a layered compliance system: automated screening where possible, human judgement where needed, clear escalation where ambiguous. Second, a culture in which the frontline team feels safer raising a concern than quietly ignoring it. Third, a direct relationship with the regulators themselves, built in calm times so that it exists when a hard conversation becomes necessary.

Although most compliance incidents are caught by the system, it is the culture and the relationship that prevent the worst outcomes. Even though this work is slow and often invisible, it is what separates the companies that stay off the front page from those that do not.

items.q: According to the text, how are customs and compliance best described at enterprise level?
options: A cost centre with little strategic weight
Strategic disciplines that shape where a company can operate
Operational tasks handled by the frontline
items.why: "they are strategic disciplines that increasingly shape where a company can operate".

items.q: What are the three things senior leaders invest in?
options: A layered compliance system, a speak-up culture and a direct relationship with regulators
items.why: O segundo parágrafo lista os três: sistema em camadas, cultura de levantar preocupações e relação direta com os reguladores.

items.q: Why does the text say the relationship with regulators should be built "in calm times"?
options: So that it already exists when a hard conversation becomes necessary
Because regulators are only available when there is no crisis
Because it is cheaper to do so
So the company can avoid audits entirely
items.why: "built in calm times so that it exists when a hard conversation becomes necessary."

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: A careless declared value can have long-term consequences.
Once the automated system is in place, culture no longer matters.
Compliance work is often slow and invisible.
items.why: Inferência: o texto insiste que são a cultura e a relação — não só o sistema — que evitam os piores desfechos.

items.q: The phrase "costs quietly for a decade" suggests that…
options: the fine is paid in yearly instalments
the damage is immediate and easy to measure
the harm is gradual, hidden and long-lasting
the cost is minor and soon forgotten
items.why: Inferência: "quietly" e "for a decade" indicam um dano lento, discreto e prolongado, não um golpe único e visível.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Charlotte reconstruindo a estratégia aduaneira depois do erro de valor declarado. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Let me be candid about where we are. A single declared-value error in one market — a rounding mistake, honestly — has quietly raised questions across three others. Nobody was fined. That is not the point. The point is that regulators talk to each other, and they do not forget.

So I am not going to stand here and blame the analyst who keyed the figure. If our system let a careless value pass without a second pair of eyes, that is a design failure, not a personal one. Even though the automation caught ninety per cent of last year's exceptions, it was the ten per cent it missed that could have marked us.

Here is what I am proposing. We build the screening in layers — automated where the rules are clear, human judgement where they are not, and a fast escalation path the moment something looks ambiguous. And I want the frontline team to feel safer flagging a doubt than swallowing it.

Despite all the technology we have bought, none of that protects us if people stay quiet. Culture is the control that never shows up on the dashboard.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What triggered the questions across the other three markets?
options: A large fine in one market
A single declared-value error — a rounding mistake
items.why: "A single declared-value error in one market — a rounding mistake, honestly."

items.q: Who does Charlotte say is to blame for the error?
options: The system design, which let a careless value pass
The analyst who keyed the figure
The regulators in the other markets
items.why: "If our system let a careless value pass without a second pair of eyes, that is a design failure, not a personal one."

items.q: How does Charlotte propose to build the screening?
options: In layers — automated, human judgement, and fast escalation
Entirely by hand to avoid software errors
Fully automated with no human review
items.why: "We build the screening in layers — automated where the rules are clear, human judgement where they are not, and a fast escalation path."

items.q: What does Charlotte mean by "Culture is the control that never shows up on the dashboard"?
options: Dashboards are unreliable and should be removed
The dashboard needs a new culture module
Culture is less important than technology
The most important safeguard cannot be measured by the metrics
items.why: Inferência: o salvaguarda decisiva — pessoas falarem — não aparece nos números, mas é o que realmente protege.

items.q: How would you best describe Charlotte's stance?
options: Dismissive of the incident as trivial
Defensive and eager to assign individual blame
Accountable — she treats it as a systemic failure and proposes a fix
Focused only on buying more technology
items.why: Inferência: ela recusa culpar a pessoa, chama de falha de design e propõe camadas e cultura — postura de dono do problema.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "A sanctions oversight, even years ago, can close doors today." Here, oversight means…
options: a failure to notice or check something
items.why: Oversight = descuido, algo que passou despercebido (não confundir com "supervisão", o outro sentido da palavra).

items.q: Choose the correct term: "A declared value that looks ___ can mark the whole organisation for a decade."
items.why: Careless = descuidado; um valor que parece feito sem cuidado levanta suspeita.

items.q: Escalation in a compliance system refers to…
options: raising a case to a higher level for a decision
items.why: Escalation = escalonamento: levar o caso a um nível superior quando ele é ambíguo ou grave.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The rules are clear here, but this case is genuinely ___, so it needs human judgement."
items.why: Ambiguous = ambíguo; quando não está claro, entra o julgamento humano.

items.q: The frontline team is best described as…
options: the staff who deal with the transactions first-hand
items.why: Frontline team = equipe da linha de frente, quem lida diretamente com as operações e é a primeira defesa de compliance.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de compliance e estratégia. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Legal still has to sign off on the new screening protocol." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the layered checks market by market." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva.

items.q: "Two country managers pushed back on the extra manual review." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar de algo sem necessariamente rejeitá-lo por completo.

items.q: "The team agreed the escalation path but never followed through." They…
options: failed to carry it to completion
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "If nobody speaks up, no amount of software will move the needle on real risk." This means it will…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, fazer uma diferença perceptível.
